description:
pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:606-626

DeviationRunResult derives Clone, Debug, Default but not PartialEq. Its fields (Vec<Finding>, Vec<DeviatedFinding>) both implement PartialEq. Adding PartialEq would allow test code to use assert_eq!(result, expected) for full structural equality instead of checking individual fields.

Fix: add PartialEq to derive.
title: M1: DeviationRunResult missing PartialEq derive
